questions.q: Choose the correct phrasal verb: “The patient's fever has not ____ even after three days.”
questions.why: 'Come down' means to decrease, as of a fever. GPSC-style practice item.

opts: He was tired; however, he continued working.
He was tired; however he, continued working.
He was tired, however, he continued working.
He was tired however; he continued working.
questions.why: A semicolon precedes the conjunctive adverb 'however', followed by a comma. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct modal: “She dare not ____ the Principal.”
questions.why: The modal 'dare' is followed by the bare infinitive. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: “Water ______ at 100 °C at sea level.”
questions.why: Universal truths take the simple present. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct modal: “You ______ have told me earlier; I could have helped.”
questions.why: 'Should have' + past participle expresses a past action that was advisable but not done. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: “The red scarf was a perfect ____ to her white dress.”
questions.why: 'Complement' means something that completes; 'compliment' means praise. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct version: “She was too tired that she could not walk.”
opts: She was such tired that she could not walk.
She was too tired to she could not walk.
She was so tired as she could not walk.
She was so tired that she could not walk.
questions.why: 'So ... that' expresses result; 'too' needs 'to + verb'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: “The study of the origin and history of words”
questions.why: Etymology traces the origin and development of words. GPSC-style practice item.
Silent p: pneu-mo-nia. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct option: “I wish I ______ the answer to your question.”
questions.why: 'Wish' about the present takes the past form (subjunctive). GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
